title: Lava Walker Enchantment
description: Adds a 'Lava Walker' enchantment to walk on lava pools by turning them into basalt.
body:
# **Lava Walker Enchantment Mod**

This mod introduces the Lava Walker enchantment, allowing you to traverse vast lava lakes safely.

## **How it works:**
**Transformation:** As you walk on lava, it instantly turns into Molten Basalt beneath your feet.

**Block States:** The basalt features 3 visual stages. It will gradually crack and cool down before reverting back into lava.

**Requirements & Limitations:** * Only works on Lava Source blocks (still lava). It does not work on flowing lava or waterfalls.

**Requires Air above the lava** (it won't trigger if there are blocks directly on top of the lava).

**Temperature Mechanics:** Molten Basalt melts significantly faster in the Nether due to the extreme heat, while it remains stable for longer in the Overworld.

## **Enchantment Compatibility:**
To maintain game balance, this enchantment is **incompatible with Frost Walker**. You cannot have both on the same pair of boots!

## **Obtaining:**
Lava Walker can be obtained through the following methods:

**Enchantment Table:** Use your levels and lapis lazuli to get it on any pair of boots.

**Enchanted Books:** Can be found in dungeon chests or through Librarian Villager trades.

**Loot:** Occasionally appears in Bastion Remnants and Ruined Portals.
